rules.title: zig fmt
rules.text: Format code with zig fmt before committing.

rules.title: Targeted tests
rules.text: Run targeted tests with zig build test -Dtest-filter=<name>. The full suite is slow.

rules.title: Explicit allocators
rules.text: Pass allocators explicitly, free with defer and use errdefer for cleanup on error paths.

rules.title: Handle error unions
rules.text: Return error unions and handle them with try and catch. Do not discard errors.

rules.title: Debug builds first
rules.text: Develop and test in Debug, which keeps safety checks on, and choose a Release mode deliberately.

rules.title: Skip unneeded targets
rules.text: Use the project build options to skip platform-specific app bundles you are not touching.

rules.title: Readable comptime
rules.text: Use comptime for generics and compile-time checks, but keep it readable.
